parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: A wooden drawer that slides in and out of the table structure.
parts.Functional_description: Used for storing small items such as stationery or documents.
parts.Movement_description: It can slide horizontally in and out along rails.

parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: A second wooden drawer similar to the first one, part of the table’s storage system.
parts.Functional_description: Provides additional storage space for organizing items.
parts.Movement_description: It can slide horizontally in and out along rails.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: A horizontal wooden shelf inside the table structure.
parts.Functional_description: Supports drawers and provides internal structural stability.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Back Panel
parts.Basic_description: A flat wooden panel located at the back of the table.
parts.Functional_description: Provides structural support and prevents items from falling out the back.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Vertical Side Panel
parts.Basic_description: A vertical wooden side panel forming one side of the drawer compartment.
parts.Functional_description: Provides lateral support and defines the side boundary of the drawer section.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Vertical Side Panel
parts.Basic_description: Another vertical wooden side panel forming the opposite side of the drawer compartment.
parts.Functional_description: Provides lateral support and defines the opposite side boundary of the drawer section.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Bottom Panel
parts.Basic_description: A flat wooden panel forming the bottom of the drawer compartment.
parts.Functional_description: Supports the weight of drawers and items stored inside.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Leg
parts.Basic_description: A cylindrical metal leg supporting one corner of the table.
parts.Functional_description: Provides vertical support and stability to the table.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Leg
parts.Basic_description: A second cylindrical metal leg supporting another corner of the table.
parts.Functional_description: Provides vertical support and stability to the table.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Leg
parts.Basic_description: A third cylindrical metal leg supporting the table structure.
parts.Functional_description: Provides vertical support and stability to the table.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: An additional internal wooden shelf located above the drawers.
parts.Functional_description: Provides extra support and separation between drawers.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Tabletop
parts.Basic_description: The main flat wooden surface of the table.
parts.Functional_description: Provides a working surface for writing, placing objects, or using a computer.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.
